subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood Inference trial for Tide Commerce
messages:
From: Kate Morris <kate@tidecommerce.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Demo request: Redwood Inference trial

Hi Dylan,

I signed up for a trial this morning and landed on Redwood's docs — looks promising. We're Tide Commerce (ecommerce search + personalization) and are evaluating inference platforms for relevance scoring and on-the-fly reranking. I'd love a short walkthrough of the product and to understand fit & pricing.

High-level details:
- Primary use case: product search relevance + boosting for promotions
- Expected monthly volume: ~500k queries/month now, planning for growth to ~1.5M in 6–9 months
- Peak latency requirement: p95 < 200ms for production queries
- Timeline: pilot in ~6 weeks, production in Q3 if pilot goes well

Would you be able to demo next week? I'm Pacific time (PST) and prefer mornings. Also cc'ing procurement (procurement@tidecommerce.com) who will want to see SLA/pricing cadence.

Thanks,
Kate Morris
Product Manager — Search
Tide Commerce
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Kate Morris <kate@tidecommerce.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood Inference trial

Hi Kate — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. I'm Dylan on the Redwood SDR/solutions team; I'll coordinate a short live demo and loop in Marissa (solutions engineer) to cover architecture and sizing. Before we lock a slot, a couple quick questions so we tailor the session: 

1) Which environment are you most interested in — hosted (Redwood API), Dedicated (reserved GPU), or Private (VPC/on-prem)?
2) Is the 500k/month estimate queries, generation tokens, or unique users? Any sense of burst qps during peak events?
3) Any data sensitivity or PII concerns we should flag (PCI, PHI, customer IDs that can't leave your VPC)?
4) Who will attend from your side (roles) and do you want a 30 or 45 minute session?

Proposed times (PST mornings next week):
- Tue 02/24 09:30–10:15
- Wed 02/25 08:30–09:15
- Thu 02/26 10:00–10:45

If none of those work, you can pick a time here: https://cal.redwood.com/dylan/30min

Attached a short product one-pager and a suggested agenda. We'll be prepared to talk sample latency profiles, caching/batching options, and a rough cost estimate.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
SDR, Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- redwood_product_one_pager.pdf (PDF)
- suggested_demo_agenda.docx (DOCX)
From: Kate Morris <kate@tidecommerce.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@tidecommerce.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood Inference trial

Thanks, Dylan — appreciate the quick follow-up. Answers below: 

1) We're evaluating hosted first (fast time-to-value) but need clarity on Dedicated for predictable costs if we scale. 
2) 500k refers to inference requests (single API call per search). Peak is around 120 qps during flash sales; sustained baseline ~15 qps.
3) We store user IDs and order metadata — not PHI or PCI, but we do want controls around retention and ability to turn on customer-managed KMS.
4) Attendees: me (PM), Andrew Li (backend lead), and Maya Patel (data security). 45 minutes would be ideal.

Proposed time: Wed 02/25 08:30 PST works for us. If that slot is still open, please confirm and send calendar invite. Procurement looped in for SLA/pricing packaging — they'll review any pre-demo materials.

Also: can you point us to SOC 2 and data residency docs ahead of the meeting?

—Kate

To: Kate Morris <kate@tidecommerce.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, procurement@tidecommerce.com

Perfect — Wed 02/25 08:30–09:15 PST is tentatively held. I'll send a calendar invite for 45 minutes and include a short agenda:

Agenda (45 min):
- 5m intros & goals
- 15m demo (hosted API + relevance/rerank flow)
- 15m sizing, latency profiles, caching/batching options + cost sketch
- 5m security/compliance Q&A (SOC 2, KMS, data residency)
- 5m next steps (pilot plan)

Attaching the one-pager again and a link to our SOC 2 + compliance page for procurement: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-tdc-demo-materials (we'll add the SOC2 report stub there). Marissa will run the demo and handle the technical deep-dive.

Expect a calendar invite in the next couple hours (I'll route through GCal). If procurement wants an NDA or scope doc beforehand, let me know and I can share a template.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Dylan
